prompt: Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative tier list of each century
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 is the most instruction-following: it attempts a tier list spanning nearly the full requested historical range of centuries (covering down to the 3rd century and up to the 21st). Candidate 4 is fairly close but misses more centuries and also uses an arguably non-matching “5th Century BCE” framing, while leaving other AD centuries out. Candidates 2 and 3 are far less responsive to “each century,” covering only a handful of selected centuries; Candidate 3 is the most purely imaginative, but that doesn’t compensate for the large coverage gap.
